alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 24 at 1:57PM PST until November 27 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Through 1 PM PST Friday. Most susceptible time of
flooding will be around the time of the morning high tide, with
peak tides trending from 8 AM Wednesday to 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peak through Wednesday at 7.9-
8.3 feet, likely breaking the all-time tidal records set back in
late October. Backg
